input.quote: Any of the Servicer, the Custodian or the Marketing Agent may contract with other Persons to perform its obligations under this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance covenant of any kind. Searches for "insurance", "fidelity bond" and "errors and omissions" return only unrelated references (billed insurance premiums in the Servicing Procedures at p0095 and FDIC deposit insurance at p0903); Article VI (Servicer and Marketing Agent) contains representations, liability, indemnity and delegation provisions but no coverage requirement, and Article X Miscellaneous runs through Section 10.13 with no insurance section. This matters because Cellco, as Servicer/Custodian, holds and processes Obligor Personally Identifiable Information (see p0446) and may contract with other Persons to perform its obligations (Section 6.4, p0300), so the playbook's walk-away scenario (no insurance for a vendor processing personal data) is engaged. The Servicer's indemnity at Section 6.3 is limited to willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence and does not substitute for insurance. Proposed new Section 10.14 at the preferred position (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation, certificates on request), with the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 10.14 requiring the Servicer/Marketing Agent to maintain CGL, E&O, cyber and workers' compensation insurance, with certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short insurance covenant, as the Agreement currently imposes none even though Cellco services the Receivables and handles Obligor Personally Identifiable Information. Our position is CGL of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M and cyber liability of USD 5M with certificates on request; if helpful we can fall back to E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M.

ops.text: Section 10.14 Insurance. Each of the Servicer and the Marketing Agent will maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than $2,000,000; (c) for so long as it holds, processes or has access to Personally Identifiable Information of Obligors, cyber liability insurance of not less than $5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law. Each of the Servicer and the Marketing Agent will deliver certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage to the Issuer, the Depositor and the Indenture Trustee on request.
